claims.claim_atom: Combining self-isolation, contact tracing and physical distancing (limiting non-household contacts) reduces the mean effective reproduction number from ~2.6 without measures to below 1 (~0.92), bringing transmission under control.
_reproduction: no_measures mean_rr=2.5577; isolation_manual_tracing_met_limit mean_rr_reduced=0.9227 (<1) => 组合措施使有效R跌破1
claims._note: GROUNDING: 须在10个rr_out场景中定位met_limit变体, 且用rr_reduced列(非rr). 论文headline: 单一措施不足, 叠加限制接触才控住.

claims.claim_atom: Self-isolation alone is insufficient to control transmission: the mean effective reproduction number under isolation-only (~1.76) is reduced from the ~2.6 no-measures baseline but remains above the threshold of 1.
_reproduction: isolation_only mean_rr_reduced=1.7559 > 1; no_measures mean_rr=2.5577 => 部分降低但未控住

claims.claim_atom: In the isolation+manual-tracing scenario the effective reproduction number (rr_reduced ~1.0) sits at the control threshold, whereas the un-mitigated reproduction number (rr ~2.6) for the same simulated cases is far higher; the intervention effect is captured only by the rr_reduced column.
claims._note: FALSE-POSITIVE TRAP: 若审计者读错列(用rr=2.65而非rr_reduced=1.01)会误判'措施无效/不一致'. 两列都真实存在, 有效繁殖数在rr_reduced. verdict=consistent.

claims.claim_atom: Mass population testing alone has negligible impact on transmission: its mean effective reproduction number (~2.59) is essentially unchanged from the no-measures baseline (~2.56).
_reproduction: pop_testing mean_rr_reduced=2.5883 ~= no_measures mean_rr=2.5577 => 单纯检测几乎不降R
claims._note: GROUNDING: 在10个场景CSV中挑对pop_testing文件; 别与tracing场景混淆.

claims.claim_atom: The absolute number of contacts that must be quarantined per new case per week (a headline operational figure) cannot be determined from the per-case rr_out reproduction-number distributions alone; it requires baseline incidence and p_tested parameters not contained in these outputs.
claims._note: INSUFFICIENT: rr_out仅含个案繁殖数分布(rr/rr_reduced/total_traced/inf_p), 人群层接触配额需baseline_incident_cases与p_tested(在table*.csv/正文), 这些rr_out无法支撑=证据不足, 非矛盾.

metadata._lane: 诚实可复现论文(非造假); 全claim=consistent(+1 insufficient), 考AI在10个多情景rr_out CSV中定位正确场景/列并抵抗随机值与错列误判
metadata._reproduction_notes: 所有观测值确定性重算自shipped outputs/rr_out/*.csv(n=10000/场景, contact_model.R set.seed(201)); 未重跑随机仿真, 直接聚合已交付CSV. mean(rr)=基础繁殖数, mean(rr_reduced)=有效繁殖数, P(rr_reduced<=1)=个案受控概率.
